review_brief:
# Review — second adversarial round on two native parametric builds

- Assignment: `review-e39ac27af73ef0f1`; targets `027805c8ff0f` and `8ead1e696890`.
- The second audit found a shared shortcut: each supposedly input-derived intermediate was encoded by fixed train/test dimensions. Both families now use deterministic seed-shuffled schedules independent of those dimensions.
- `027805c8ff0f` also failed one 30-row axis-swapping stress case; placement now keeps all three panels spatially informative for transform codes 2 and 4.
- `8ead1e696890` ordinary cases used only singleton border objects, permitting “keep nonzero border cells”; every ordinary case now contains an inward-reaching two-cell border component.
- `8ead1e696890` also had a reversed left-border preference that could empty the lower-left quadrant at 30×30; the stress layout is repaired.
- Focused suite: 75/75 passed. Isolated staged suites: 31/31 for `027805c8ff0f`, 44/44 for `8ead1e696890`.
- Adversarial sweeps: all fixed profiles covered transform codes 2–6 or areas 1–5; 512 ordinary `8ead1e696890` samples all retained an inward-reaching border component.
- Protected-Racket qualification passed for both targets with four jobs and 32 evaluations each; fresh causal witnesses replayed successfully.
- Four-episode public projections produced 16 one-query views per target and passed saved-export, private-field invariance, and positive-control checks.
- Status: reviewer-ready. Exact-source owner acceptance and training admission remain false and were not claimed.

## `027805c8ff0f`

The first round repaired the ignored `shape_k` control, strict override handling, degenerate-texture handling, and A→B self-check, then added exact-canonical apply-once and apply-twice settings. The second round attacked the intermediate itself. Previously, the transform code was fixed by profile dimensions, so a solver could infer it without reading A→B. The generator now derives a deterministic shuffled code schedule from the episode seed, independently for train and test positions. Across 128 adversarial seeds, every train/test profile position covered all codes 2–6.

A 30×29 axis-swapping case then exposed a placement interaction: 90°/transpose layouts could collapse transformed content into the upper strip. A regression now requires non-divider occupancy in all four quadrants; the corrected stress sweep over 128 seed

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The input-derived area of the unique component touching the top border.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Find the unique component touching the top border and measure its area.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Keep every component in the grid whose area equals the measured reference area.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Step B cannot know which component size to select until Step A measures the reference; forcing area 3 on this qualified area-2 case changes the final grid.

parametric_work.summary: Exact canonical border-setting plus a top-area setting. Reference area is now seed-shuffled independently of fixed profile dimensions; every train/test profile covered areas 1–5. Ordinary cases always contain an inward-reaching multi-cell border component, so success requires component reasoning rather than retaining nonzero border cells. Protected-Racket qualification, causal replay, and public/privacy checks passed.
